
```{devoirs_choices coefficient_9_two_choices}

- A value that must be the same in every regression model.:

- A scalar used to scale a function or quantity before combining it with other terms.:

    feedback: Correct.
- A label naming the units of the output, such as points or dollars.:

- A conversion factor that turns an input quantity into units of the model output.:
```
